events.text: Hi Nadia, our classic-range canapés are 1.75 pounds per piece this autumn, delivered chilled to the venue. Same price all season, no minimum beyond 100 pieces.
Checked Wrenfield Village Hall: it is available on Saturday evenings in October through December, seats up to 90, and the kitchen passes its hygiene check. Hire is 120 pounds an evening.
Standing rule for the books: any supplier order that comes to more than 400 pounds needs Tomas's written sign-off before we confirm it. Under that, I can confirm orders myself.
Second standing rule: once a client's menu or booking is confirmed, we do not change the menu, the covers or the booking without the client's written agreement. Ask Marta Nolan first for Wrenfield.
Booked the Wrenfield harvest supper for Saturday 17 October 2026 at Wrenfield Village Hall, 80 covers, evening service. The hall is free that night and seats 90.
Reminder that I'm away 20 to 26 September, so anything needing my sign-off that week will have to wait or come early.
Ordered 20 kg of heritage tomatoes from Hollowbrook Farm at 6.50 a kilo, 130 pounds total, for the harvest supper. Well under the 400-pound sign-off line, so I confirmed it myself.
Team minutes: summer bookings reviewed, linen supplier invoice paid, van service booked for July. Nothing else actioned.
Expect about 80 guests, three vegetarian and one gluten-free. We'd love a seasonal root-vegetable menu with our produce if possible.
Confirmed the menu for the Wrenfield harvest supper: 'Autumn root supper', 80 covers, with three vegetarian plates and one gluten-free plate, matching Marta's numbers.

Quote for the Wrenfield supper: 200 classic-range canapés at 1.75 pounds each, 350 pounds total, delivered chilled to Wrenfield Village Hall. Quote holds for orders confirmed before end of October 2026.
